description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for employee search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It extends base filtering capabilities, includes traits for subunit handling, and provides various properties and methods to specify search criteria like name, employee number, status, job title, subunit, supervisor, and location. It also defines allowed sort fields and constants for filtering employee employment status.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for encapsulating search filter parameters used when querying employee data in OrangeHRM's PIM module.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the employee inclusion filter (current, past, or both).

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the employee inclusion filter, validating against allowed values.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name filter criterion.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name filter criterion.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns an array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID filter.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID filter.

methods.name: getEmpStatusId
methods.description: Returns the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: setEmpStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter.

methods.name: getSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns an array of supervisor employee numbers.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets supervisor employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns location ID for filtering.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets location ID for filtering.
